children: Delhi-based water treatment company Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd on Tuesday (September 8) said its step-down subsidiary Suyog Urja Limited has been awarded a ₹189.99 crore contract, excluding GST, by Tata Power Renewable Energy Ltd for execution of Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) turnkey works for development of a 180 MW NTPC Wind Power Project at Parli, Maharashtra.

The contract was awarded on September 7, 2026, and is scheduled to be executed by March 31, 2027. Suyog Urja Ltd received the contract for wind turbine generator foundation works, Balance of Plant works and 33-kilovolt transmission line construction and commissioning.
Under the contract, the company will undertake Wind Turbine Generator foundation works, including supply of reinforcement steel and geotechnical works.

The Balance of Plant scope includes development of a fully equipped 39-acre secure storage yard, coordination of Right of Way for material transport, and construction of permanent and temporary roads, pathways and crane pads.

The scope also includes construction and commissioning of 33-kilovolt transmission line works for the project. The order has been awarded by a domestic entity and is classified as a domestic contract for EPC turnkey services.

Enviro Infra Engineers said the promoter, promoter group and group companies have no interest in Tata Power Renewable Energy Ltd, the entity awarding the contract. The company also said the order does not fall under related-party transactions.
Shares of Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd ended at ₹196.20, down by ₹1.85, or 0.93%, on the BSE.

title: Enviro Infra bags ₹190 crore wind power project order from Tata Power Renewable Energy
